{{redirect|S11|the Japanese TCG release with the set symbol S11|Lost Origin (TCG)}} {{Season Infobox |background=AAF |cellcolor=FCC |name=Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension |image=Pokémon Battle Dimension logo.png |caption=Logo for the season |number=11 |opening=We Will Be Heroes |numeps=52 |region=[[Sinnoh]] |series=''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]'' |prev=Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl |next=Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles }} '''Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension''' is the eleventh [[season]] of the [[dub]]bed version of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It is the second season of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]''. It follows {{Ash}} as he continues gathering [[Badge]]s in [[Sinnoh]], and {{an|Dawn}} as she continues gathering [[Ribbon]]s. It originally aired in {{pmin|the United States}} as part of the 2008-2009 {{wp|Cartoon Network}} Saturday morning lineup. It began on April 12, 2008 with the dub premiere ''[[DP053|Tears for Fears!]]'', and concluded on May 2, 2009 with ''[[DP104|Sleepless In Pre-Battle!]]''. This season began a new trend, similar to that in Japan where one episode is aired most weeks; there was no break between this season and the next one. It also began airing on digital TV's {{wp|Jetix}} in {{pmin|the United Kingdom}} in late 2008; on {{wp|Freeview (UK)|UK Freeview}}, on January 5, 2009, simultaneously on {{wp|CITV}} and {{wp|ITV4}}; and on {{wp|YTV}} in {{pmin|Canada}} owned by {{wp|Corus Entertainment}} on March 2, 2009. It is preceded by [[S10|Pokémon: Diamond and Pearl]] and succeeded by [[S12|Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles]]. ==Blurb== ''It’s looking good for Ash as he works on his next three Gym Badges, but not so good for Dawn, coming off a pair of Contest defeats. Both will do what they can to become better Trainers, from entering the Wallace Cup competition to attending Professor Rowan’s Pokémon Summer Academy. Hopefully, the new tactics they pick up will give them the tools they need to succeed against the latest plot by Pokémon Hunter J—as well as the emerging threat of Team Galactic!'' ==Important events== {{spoilers}} * {{AP|Chimchar}} realizes that {{Ash}} is a caring {{pkmn|Trainer}}, unlike [[Paul]]. Chimchar gets over its fear of {{p|Zangoose}}. ([[DP053]]) * [[Gardenia]] reappears for an episode. ([[DP054]]) * [[Zoey]] suggests that Ash and {{an|Dawn}} trade {{AP|Aipom}} and {{TP|Dawn|Buizel}}. ([[DP055]]) * Buizel destroys the [[Hallowed Tower]], and Ash needs to repair it, according to a legend. ([[DP056]]) * [[Team Galactic]]'s [[Saturn]] and two {{tc|Team Galactic Grunt|Grunts}} disturb the {{p|Unown}} in the [[Solaceon Ruins]]. ([[DP060]]) * [[Jessie]] wins her first [[Ribbon]]. ([[DP061]]) * Dawn loses her second [[Pokémon Contest]] in a row and loses confidence in herself. ([[DP061]]) * Dawn meets another of her childhood friends, [[Leona]]. ([[DP063]]) * [[Butch]] and [[Cassidy]], and the recurring {{OBP|Hippopotas|recurring}} make another appearance. ([[DP065]]) * Ash and {{ashfr}} meet Paul's older brother [[Reggie]], a {{tc|Pokémon Breeder}}. ([[DP066]]) * Dawn has a [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}} against [[Maylene]], which she loses. ([[DP067]]) * Team Galactic reappears in [[Veilstone City]] to steal meteorites. Ash, his friends, Reggie, and Maylene stop them. ([[DP069]]) * Ash and his friends help [[Kellyn]] protect an [[Aura]]-using {{FB|Aura Sphere|Riolu}} from [[J]] and her client. ([[DP071]] and [[DP072]]) * [[Wallace]] appears as a master {{pkmn|Coordinator}} and announces the [[Wallace Cup]]. ([[DP075]]) * {{an|May}} returns to participate in the Wallace Cup, along with Ash, Dawn, Jessie and Zoey. ([[DP076]]) * The Wallace Cup takes place at the [[Valor Lakefront]]. ([[DP077]] - [[DP079]]) ** Ash, Dawn, May, Zoey, and {{si|Kyle}} advance to the [[Contest Battle|Battle Stage]] while Jessie loses in the [[Appeal|Performance Stage]]. ([[DP077]]) ** Ash battles Kyle in the quarter-finals and loses. May, Dawn, Zoey, and Kyle advance to the semi-finals. ([[DP078]]) ** Dawn defeats Kyle in the semi-finals, while May defeats Zoey. ([[DP079]]) ** Dawn defeats May in the finals and becomes the Wallace Cup winner, earning the {{DL|Ribbon|Aqua Ribbon}}. ([[DP079]]) * Jessie catches a {{p|Yanma}} which evolves to {{TP|Jessie|Yanmega}}. ([[DP080]]) * Ash meets up with Paul and they have a battle. Chimchar reveals its true power. ([[DP081]]) * Ash meets up with and battles {{Gary}}, who gives him a [[Razor Fang]]. ([[DP085]]) * Ash and his friends enter the [[Pokémon Summer Academy]] where they meet and befriend [[Angie]]. ([[DP088]] to [[DP091]]) * Ash meets up with [[Fantina]]. They have an informal battle which Ash forfeits. ([[DP093]]) * Dawn meets and competes against [[Lila]], an old rival of [[Johanna|her mother]], in the {{to|Celestic}} Constest. She also wins her third Ribbon. ([[DP095]]) * Ash and his friends encounter {{an|Cynthia}} and meet [[Professor Carolina]] at the [[Celestic Town Historical Research Center]]. [[Cyrus]] also makes an appearance as an interested businessman. ([[DP096]] and [[DP097]]) * Team Galactic steals the Lustrous and Adamant Orbs. ([[DP096]] and [[DP097]]) * Ash and his friends meet up with Angie again in [[Solaceon Town]]. ([[DP098]]) * The group meets [[Aaron]] of the [[Elite Four]], who is looking for his lost {{TP|Aaron|Wurmple}}. ([[DP099]]) * On the way to the [[Hearthome Gym]] for a battle, Ash literally runs into {{an|Barry}}, a Trainer from [[Twinleaf Town]] who admires Paul's training style. ([[DP101]]) * Jessie wins her second Ribbon. ([[DP102]]) * After Ash's victory at the Hearthome Gym, Barry declares Ash as his rival.
